root_idea.summary: The attested lexical field centers on the date-palm raceme or stalk, especially its dry, slender, curved remnant.
root_idea.development: The base noun denotes a palm raceme or its remaining stalk; its characteristic slenderness and curvature motivate the Quranic comparison with the moon. Derived usages extend the vocabulary to striking with a raceme or stick and to raceme-patterned cloth, while a separate plant sense is also recorded.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested nominal headword, normalized from the oblique surface form to the citation form عُرْجُون.

senses.definition: A date-palm raceme or stalk, especially the old, dry, slender, curved base or main stalk left after the fruit-stalks have been removed.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic comparison, the waning moon is likened to the old form of this stalk for its slenderness and curvature. The cited Quran-focused interpretation relates the object to the raceme's clustered or layered branches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or beat with a date-palm raceme or a stick.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive derived verb, attested in a construction using the raceme or stick as the instrument.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To figure or decorate a garment or piece of cloth with forms of date-palm racemes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived verb describing the application of raceme-shaped designs; عَرَاجِين is the plural of عُرْجُون.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To smear or rub over a person or thing with blood, saffron, or henna-like dye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived transitive usage specifying the material applied to the surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A white fungus-like plant, compared with a toadstool or a white truffle; when dry, it takes on a rounded form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate botanical usage from the date-palm raceme sense; its plural is reported as عَرَاجِين.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or piece of cloth patterned with forms of date-palm racemes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived descriptive or resultative form referring to cloth bearing raceme-shaped designs.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The striking or beating construction is represented.
The smearing or rubbing construction is represented.
The date-palm raceme, dry curved stalk, and Quranic comparison are represented.
The separate fungus-like plant usage is represented.
The patterned-cloth descriptive form is represented.

cautions: The Quranic occurrence is recorded by QAC as the oblique form عُرْجُونِ; the public headword is normalized to عُرْجُون.
The fungus-like plant usage is a separate Classical Arabic branch and should not be conflated with the Quranic date-palm stalk sense.
